task.description: REVIEWER hard gate (decision-record consistency, scope creep, honesty) on docs/migration/decisions/0044-hybrid-identity-model.md at HEAD of branch docs/ADR-hybrid-identity. CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASS (after 3 reworks) and SECURITY-REVIEWER RATIFIED. Check: (1) the branch diff vs origin/main touches only the ADR, handoffs/ADHOC-20261005-001/*, handoffs/registry.json, handoffs/orchestrator.log and 7 `hold:` lines in docs/requirements.yaml (verify with git diff --stat origin/main and that the yaml still parses and no status/depends_on changed); (2) consistency with 0002, 0006, 0012, 0035, 0038, 0042, 0043: read each record's relevant passages in full and confirm every 'consistent / amends / supersedes' claim in the ADR sections 2.3.4 and 6 is true, that amend-by-reference vs supersession is chosen the way 0038/0042 chose it, and that nothing the ratified records forbid is silently done (esp. 0006 D1/R5/s7.3, 0038 four conditions, 0042 standing prohibitions 1-14, 0043 D-A..D-H and its flagged conflicts); (3) Phase 1 = O1 really leaves every ratified record intact and the PR #2201 disposition (hold, then merge with 0043 D-C delta) is consistent with 0043 D-F/D-C and with the PR's actual state (gh pr view 2201 -R tvolodi/letflow: check state/merge hold/CI); (4) scope creep: the record decides a direction and gates, it must not smuggle implementation, new requirements ids or requirement edits; the recommendation must be proportionate and the risk of over-engineering stated; (5) the claim that REQ-434..444 are 'stay' under the recommendation and the per-REQ table is accurate vs docs/requirements.yaml status/depends_on; (6) the ADR number 0044 is free (main + open PRs; note numbers get reused: identify by content); (7) the record is honest about what is unknown (Keycloak) and does not pre-empt the user's ratification. Write the result into this handoff's 'result' (status PASS/FAIL, summary, issues[]), set status COMPLETED, take times from `date -u`; do not spawn agents; do not commit.
